scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test:guard: npm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-reporter spec test/mobileOwnedFunctions.test.ts
scripts.test:run: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && node --import tsx --test --test-reporter spec test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:parking: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-ferromaps-parking "npm run test:run"
scripts.test:surge: node --import tsx --test --test-reporter spec test/surgeSheet.test.ts test/surgeSheet.backtest.test.ts test/categoryForecast.test.ts test/forecastHistory.test.ts test/hotspotTestPins.test.ts test/watchlistForecast.test.ts test/missingPlaces.test.ts test/pickupVerify.test.ts
scripts.test:surge:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.emulator.json --project demo-ferromaps-stadium-surge --only firestore "node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter spec test/surgeSheet.emulator.test.ts test/categoryForecast.emulator.test.ts test/forecastHistory.emulator.test.ts test/missingPlaces.emulator.test.ts test/hotspotForecasts.emulator.test.ts"
